# U123: The manager on Home: Rhea’s “Your team · CI/CD” opens the My team scope of Goals with the same total; “{k} need attention that aren’t yours” lists up to four, each with its owner’s name first, and opens Goals filtered to Owner not you, whose count line says k

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `HOME-MANAGER`
- **Budget:** at most 4 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U123

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Home rule 4 (HM3): the team set is exactly the Goals page's My team scope, so the block's total is the tab's count.
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** The “Your team” part (`[data-part="Your team"]`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/^Your team · CI\/CD · \d+ goals?$/.test(head) && total > 0`, where `const block = p.locator('[data-part="Your team"]')`; `const head = (await block.locator('h2').innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`; `const total = Number((head.match(/· (\d+) goals?$/) || [])[1])`. Else it says: Your team’s heading is “{head}”.
- _Note:_ Its counts are shapes and words that add up to the total, and open the team scope by status.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `counts.length > 0 && counts.every((c) => c.shape && /\/goals\?scope=team&status=\w+/.test(c.href)) && counts.reduce((n, c) => n + parseInt(c.text, 10), 0) === total`, where `const block = p.locator('[data-part="Your team"]')`; `const head = (await block.locator('h2').innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`; `const total = Number((head.match(/· (\d+) goals?$/) || [])[1])`; `const counts = await block.locator('.home-counts a').evaluateAll((as) => as.map((a) => ({ text: a.innerText.trim(), href: a.getAttribute('href') || '', shape: !!a.querySelector('svg.status-shape') })))`. Else it says: Your team’s counts: {worked out in the journey as `counts.map((c) => c.text + ' ' + c.href).join(' | ')`}.
- _Note:_ The goals that need attention and aren't hers: each row names its owner first, never Rhea, and has no button.
- **Check:** It fails if Your team’s link says “{said}”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `await rows.count() === Math.min(4, k) && who.length === Math.min(4, k) && !who.some((w) => /Rhea/.test(w)) && await block.locator('.arow .btn').count() === 0`, where `const block = p.locator('[data-part="Your team"]')`; `const needs = block.locator('a.home-team-needs')`; `const said = await needs.innerText()`; `const k = Number((said.match(/^(\d+) needs? attention that (isn’t|aren’t) yours$/) || [])[1])`; `const rows = block.locator('.arow')`; `const who = await block.locator('.arow .arow-who').allInnerTexts()`. Else it says: Your team lists {rows.count()} rows (owners {who.join(', ')}) for {k}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ See them in Goals: the My team scope, with the same total.
- **Step.** Press the “See them in Goals” link in the “Your team” part (`[data-part="Your team"]`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals?scope=team”.
- **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
- **Check:** It fails if Your team says {total} goals but Goals says “{line}”.
- _Note:_ The link to what isn't hers opens Goals with Owner not you, and the count line says k.
- Press the browser’s Back.
- **Check:** The home team needs (`a.home-team-needs`) in the “Your team” part (`[data-part="Your team"]`) shows.
- **Step.** Press the home team needs (`a.home-team-needs`) in the “Your team” part (`[data-part="Your team"]`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “scope=team&attention=1&owner=-me”.
- **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
- **Check:** It fails if “{said}” opened Goals saying “{theirs}”.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `/Owner not you/.test(filter)`, where `const filter = await p.locator('.filter-line').first().innerText().catch(() => '')`. Else it says: the filter line says “{filter}”, not “Owner not you”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “goals”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`logged`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
